summary: Discussion signals: vendor agent rollouts (Google Gemini/Antigravity, Akamai), Anthropic/Claude policy and Claude Code billing, sandbox isolation/security reports, operator cost/workflow practices; several repo-only open-source agent projects need corroboration. | Vendor-first screening: security advisories, agent SDK/sandbox primitives, and operator case studies from AWS, Cloudflare, Cursor, E2B, JetBrains, Mistral, Modal, and others. | GitHub-first snapshot: multiple mainstream agent releases (Vercel, Cloudflare, Qwen), large agent platforms (Dify, Hyperframes), and several infra primitives for browser automation and agent security. | Package-only shard: mix of vendor SDKs/extensions (Salesforce, Oracle/OCI, Weave, WSO2) and many MCP/agent infra primitives (Rust agent loop, MCP libs, agent security tooling). No social/operator reports in this shard — follow-ups recommended for field reports and vendor docs.
